quote: A Strategic Framework for Media Growth in the Age of Fragmented Attention
reason: Subtítulo intercambiable con muchas publicaciones de estrategia; no expresa la propuesta concreta.
replacement: How media can build a habit of return across the places people already use.

quote: This section is the honest accounting of intellectual debts and the precise points of departure.
reason: La honestidad se anuncia en vez de mostrarse mediante atribución; quitar el autoelogio.
replacement: Here is what ZMOI and CMI borrow from earlier work, and where I propose extending it.

quote: One experiment answers that.
reason: El cierre convierte una prueba inicial en respuesta definitiva, aunque se propone comparar solo dos eventos.
replacement: This comparison would provide an initial test of the claim.

quote: If a prediction fails, the response is not to abandon the framework but to diagnose which layer is underperforming, adjust, and retest.
reason: Promete kill criteria pero cada resultado adverso se atribuye a la implementación. Separar diagnóstico operativo de evidencia contra la hipótesis.
replacement: A failed prediction should prompt a review of both the implementation and the claim. Retesting should not rule out revising or rejecting the framework.

quote: and category leadership follows.
reason: Promesa de resultado que excede el carácter propuesto del modelo.
replacement: Sustained presence before opinions form is the growth hypothesis CMI asks media teams to test. [Reemplaza la oración completa de One-line thesis.]

quote: CMI is not a content strategy; it is a presence architecture.
reason: La misma oposición vuelve en los destacados y en la conclusión. Definir una vez; después usar el término sin reintroducirlo.
replacement: CMI organizes repeated encounters with an editorial perspective across the channels a reader uses.

quote: In the current landscape of product development
reason: Apertura de plantilla: ubica una época sin aportar una observación.
replacement: We can build faster than we can explain what we are building. [Reemplaza la primera oración.]

quote: stable, coherent, and resonant thesis
reason: Tres calificativos abstractos; el lector necesita saber qué debe quedar claro.
replacement: clear account of who the product is for and what it helps them do

quote: they are manifesting a specific vision of the future
reason: Grandilocuencia que tapa una consecuencia de producto más útil.
replacement: they know what to build and what to leave out

quote: We are not merely shipping features; we are staking a claim about how the world should work.
reason: Oposición épica innecesaria en un argumento sobre claridad.
replacement: The features should make the product’s purpose clear to the people using it.

quote: That is the work. Everything else is execution.
reason: Remate totalizante: resta valor a la ejecución y repite la cadencia de otros finales.
replacement: Eliminar. El párrafo anterior ya termina con la decisión de acordar la historia antes de construir.

quote: The framework is sound. The logic is clean.
reason: Dos aprobaciones vagas antes de llegar al problema.
replacement: Eliminar ambas oraciones; pasar de la descripción de PMF al problema de reconocimiento.

quote: Not approximately. Exactly.
reason: La precisión absoluta no está definida y convierte una idea útil en una exigencia imposible de evaluar tal como está escrita.
replacement: Eliminar este remate y sustituir “confirms exactly” por “supports in actual use”.

quote: The Operating Narrative is where strategy becomes engineering.
reason: Frase de conferencia; conviene decir qué cambia en las decisiones.
replacement: The Operating Narrative sets constraints the product team can use when choosing features.

quote: the users who were always yours to lose
reason: Dramatización posesiva; presupone que esos usuarios ya pertenecían al producto.
replacement: the users who need the product but cannot yet see how it helps them

quote: There is a belief, so widespread it has become invisible
reason: Apertura solemne sobre una creencia que se puede nombrar directamente.
replacement: Teams often build the product before deciding how to explain it. [Reemplaza la primera oración.]

quote: The message is not the paint. It is the load-bearing wall.
reason: Metáfora de construcción sobreexplotada en la serie; el párrafo siguiente extiende la imagen sin sumar criterio.
replacement: What the product promises should shape its design from the start. [Sustituye estas dos oraciones y la continuación de la pared.]

quote: The Operating Narrative is the only document that connects strategy to execution without losing meaning at the handoff.
reason: “The only” declara superioridad exclusiva sin mostrar comparación.
replacement: The Operating Narrative gives product and communications teams a shared account of what they are building.

quote: You can re-acquire users. You cannot re-earn the clarity you chose not to build in the first place.
reason: Se repite literalmente en paper-04:413. También presenta la pérdida de claridad como irreversible sin justificarlo.
replacement: Write down the product’s claim and use it to review the next feature decision.

quote: That is the architecture. And like any architecture, the time to get it right is before anything is built; not after everything has to be torn down.
reason: También es el cierre literal de paper-04:414; la repetición hace visible la plantilla.
replacement: Eliminar después del cierre propuesto anterior.

quote: coherence does not break at launch. It breaks in year three.
reason: Falsa precisión temporal presentada como regla, aunque el fenómeno se describe como gradual y variable.
replacement: coherence can erode as the team grows and the original decisions become harder to explain.

quote: the most expensive form of organizational entropy there is, because it is invisible until it is irreversible.
reason: Superlativo e irreversibilidad sin sostén en el pasaje; inflan una observación defendible.
replacement: a gradual loss of clarity that can become expensive to reverse.

quote: An Operating Narrative that is not being used to make decisions is not governance. It is archaeology.
reason: Chiste conceptual con la misma oposición que se repite en casi toda la serie.
replacement: Keep the Operating Narrative in use: review it when the product or audience changes.

quote: You can re-acquire users. You cannot re-earn the clarity you chose not to build in the first place.
reason: Copia del final del paper-03; este ensayo necesita terminar en gobernanza a escala.
replacement: When the team changes, revisit the original claim and decide which commitments still hold.

quote: That is the architecture. And like any architecture, the time to get it right is before anything is built; not after everything has to be torn down.
reason: Segunda oración del cierre compartida con paper-03, sin vínculo específico con mantenimiento.
replacement: Eliminar después del cierre propuesto anterior.

quote: The launch is not a moment. It is an architecture.
reason: La oposición “momento / arquitectura” es una consigna más que una explicación de la secuencia.
replacement: The launch depends on work that starts before the announcement: recruiting users, tracking their behavior, and deciding what would justify scaling.

quote: Only the first constitutes evidence of fit.
reason: El resumen contradice la distinción posterior: el propio texto admite señal de retención en usuarios de cualquier canal.
replacement: Acquisition source explains exposure; sustained use provides evidence of fit across both cohorts.

quote: These three deliverables reposition the PMM from a launch manager to a fit architect.
reason: “Fit architect” agrega una etiqueta profesional sin explicar trabajo adicional.
replacement: These three deliverables make the PMM responsible for the evidence used to decide when to scale.

quote: The Signal Map is not a reporting document. It is a discipline document.
reason: Distinción verbal poco útil: un documento puede cumplir ambas funciones.
replacement: Use the Signal Map to keep acquisition volume separate from evidence of sustained use.

quote: It is also the only timeline that produces the evidence base the public launch needs to be more than a bet.
reason: Presenta un calendario propuesto como único válido; no encaja con la declaración de hipótesis no validada.
replacement: This is the timeline proposed here; teams should test whether it produces better decisions than a shorter launch process.

quote: The Map You Are Using Is Wrong
reason: Título categórico y acusatorio antes de delimitar el problema.
replacement: What the journey map leaves out

quote: That assumption was wrong before it was proven wrong.
reason: Juego verbal que no aclara nada y choca con “Not because it was wrong then” del párrafo siguiente.
replacement: These models need a clearer account of how distribution systems influence the decision.

quote: The map is always the last to know.
reason: Personificación de cierre que reemplaza una instrucción útil.
replacement: Compare the journey you planned with how people actually found and understood the product.

quote: It is the only measurement that predicts whether the relationship built will hold under pressure.
reason: Exclusividad predictiva, mientras el mismo ensayo llama a Resonance una orientación diagnóstica sin fórmula.
replacement: It asks whether the outcome served the user’s original intent, beyond whether they converted.

quote: It is worth being precise about why this happens, because the answer changes what you do about it.
reason: Anuncia precisión durante una oración entera; la explicación puede empezar directamente.
replacement: Eliminar y empezar por “The systems that eventually cost you your sovereignty…”.

quote: That is the architecture of every platform, institution, and algorithmic system that has ever extracted value from the builders who depended on it.
reason: “Every” y “ever” convierten el patrón en ley universal.
replacement: This is the dependency pattern I want to examine: useful services that become costly to leave.

quote: That is not a feature. That is the mechanism.
reason: La oposición no distingue categorías excluyentes; repite la idea anterior.
replacement: Eliminar. La oración anterior ya dice que la utilidad crea la dependencia.

quote: A platform that costs six months of transition work to exit today will cost two years in three years if the integration compounds.
reason: Proyección numérica sin base expuesta: parece una medición y está presentada como certeza.
replacement: Estimate the exit work now, then review how further integrations would change that estimate.

quote: This is not a small methodological problem. It is the entire argument.
reason: Autoénfasis en lugar de explicar el sesgo.
replacement: The visible sample excludes the content the distribution system never surfaced.

quote: Organizations making rational decisions on top of occluded data are not being irrational. They are being rational about the wrong signal.
reason: Tautología retórica: “rational / irrational / rational” ocupa espacio sin precisar el error.
replacement: Teams can mistake the content a platform rewards for the content their audience values.

quote: Origin Gravity describes a structural force that is real, not a guaranteed outcome
reason: La nota reconoce sesgo de supervivencia, pero enseguida afirma como probado el mecanismo que intenta evaluar.
replacement: Origin Gravity is a proposed explanation for these cases, not evidence that the same approach will work for every publisher

quote: If the argument here is wrong about the pace, it is not wrong about the direction.
reason: Inmuniza la conclusión contra la evidencia después de dedicar una sección a falsarla.
replacement: The direction, as well as the pace, should be revisited if these indicators do not support the argument.

quote: The following kill criteria are the honest accounting of what would constitute evidence against each construct.
reason: Segunda fórmula de “honest accounting”; la virtud no necesita anunciarse.
replacement: The following observations would count against each construct.

quote: The oldest known framework for multi-surface presence built around a single coherent lens.
reason: Atribuye a Hokusai una primacía conceptual que surge de la analogía del autor.
replacement: I use the series here as an image for a consistent perspective across different contexts.

quote: Not metaphor. Applied psychology.
reason: Dos fragmentos buscan autoridad científica sin mostrar que la aplicación propuesta esté validada.
replacement: I am using that research to propose a design model; the model still needs testing.

quote: No prior framework occupies the top-right quadrant: sustained engagement designed explicitly for deep transformation.
reason: El gráfico seleccionado no demuestra ausencia de modelos previos; autoexcepcionalismo.
replacement: This comparison places CAX around sustained engagement and changes in understanding.

quote: Campbell was not describing a storytelling technique. He was describing a structure of human transformation. The monomyth is the shape that meaningful change takes when it is made narratable.
reason: Párrafo idéntico en líneas 940 y 944; aunque uno sea destacado, la repetición inmediata frena la lectura.
replacement: Conservar una aparición y formular como uso del autor: “I use Campbell’s monomyth here as a way to describe change over time.”

quote: It is aligning itself with the deepest known pattern of how human beings grow.
reason: Superlativo que contradice la cautela anterior sobre Campbell como heurística.
replacement: It is using a narrative model to plan how readers might develop their understanding over time.

quote: and the difference between them is not technical; it is intentional.
reason: La conclusión atribuye la diferencia a intención, pero la sección ética anterior dice “Intention does not save. Structure does.”
replacement: and distinguishing them requires examining user autonomy and the accountability built into the system.

quote: Two iterations post red team
reason: Nota de proceso interno expuesta en el colofón, sin decir quién revisó ni qué cambió. No prueba uso de IA.
replacement: Eliminar de ambas apariciones; conservar autor, versión y fecha. Si se documenta revisión, identificar revisores y alcance reales.

quote: This is the return. Not an answer. A lens. The rest is the work.
reason: Cadencia de cuatro remates que se explica a sí misma después de un cierre ya extenso.
replacement: Eliminar. Cerrar con la pregunta concreta sobre qué aprende el lector al volver.

quote: But the point is not the money. The point is that the decisions were already made before I opened my eyes.
reason: Oposición preparada; el hecho es suficientemente fuerte sin anunciar qué no importa.
replacement: The decisions were already made before I opened my eyes.

quote: But here is what nobody says:
reason: Gancho de revelación exclusiva que no se sostiene ni hace falta.
replacement: Eliminar y empezar por “When the nature of the work changes…”.

quote: That is what cracks. Not headcount. Identity.
reason: Fragmentación enfática que simplifica el vínculo entre cambio laboral e identidad.
replacement: People also have to rethink the role they had built their identity around.

quote: The distance between those two points is not a career.
reason: El mismo mecanismo de cierre aparece en The Rhyme; repetirlo reduce la identidad de ambas piezas.
replacement: Eliminar el párrafo de cierre que empieza “I started in metrics”; cerrar con las decisiones ya tomadas, que son el tema propio de este ensayo.

quote: The texture of the world before intelligence became abundant.
reason: Abstracción amplia: la preocupación concreta aparece más adelante y se puede anticipar.
replacement: What happens to the habit of working through a question when an answer is always available?

quote: They are structurally incapable of giving you what you didn't know to ask for.
reason: Una incapacidad absoluta sustituye a la pregunta válida sobre sistemas optimizados para preferencias. No queda demostrada en el ensayo.
replacement: My concern is whether systems built around our stated preferences leave enough room for encounters we did not plan.

quote: Not efficiently. Seriously.
reason: Contraste llamativo entre dos cualidades compatibles. Puede sostenerse la voz de padre sin esa oposición.
replacement: Eliminar esas dos frases: “take their work seriously” ya expresa la idea.

quote: That's not a lesson about AI.
reason: Prepara otro remate universal cuando la relación con Lucas es el cierre más propio.
replacement: That is what I want to teach Lucas as this changes. [Sustituye también la frase siguiente sobre “what being a person means”.]

quote: Something is happening to the world at every scale simultaneously
reason: La escena de la cámara da paso a una universalización repentina.
replacement: I see a similar desire for limits in several of the changes discussed here

quote: That's not philosophy. That's physics.
reason: Una analogía arquitectónica se usa como prueba del argumento social.
replacement: Eliminar estas dos frases; presentar la imagen del edificio como analogía, no demostración.

quote: Because density has a shadow, and the shadow has teeth.
reason: Segunda y tercera metáfora sobre una abstracción; teatraliza el riesgo de exclusión.
replacement: The same structures that offer shelter can also exclude people.

quote: It split into two extremes with nothing in between.
reason: Binarismo que borra los casos intermedios para lograr contundencia.
replacement: I see pressure toward both large shared events and smaller communities.

quote: You're still here. You read the whole thing. That's a choice. What you do next is another one.
reason: Interpela y felicita al lector; después de la vuelta a la cámara, prolonga artificialmente el final.
replacement: Eliminar. Recomiendo terminar en “But he kept the photos. He chose what stays.” y recortar los párrafos explicativos posteriores.

quote: That's it. That simple.
reason: Enfatiza una simplicidad ya expuesta; la operación concreta permite entender la escena.
replacement: Eliminar ambas frases.

quote: Impossible to kill.
reason: Garantía absoluta dentro de una anécdota de trading; no se desprende de la estrategia descrita.
replacement: Eliminar la garantía y “so it couldn’t blow up”. Describir únicamente el tamaño de apuesta y el funcionamiento que el autor pueda respaldar.

quote: It's the only one that matters. And almost nobody is talking about it.
reason: Combina exclusividad y falsa novedad; además minimiza las escaseces materiales que el ensayo presupone resueltas.
replacement: It is the question I want to focus on here: what gives people a reason to act?

quote: This sounds like a philosophy lecture. It's a business model.
reason: Eslogan que declara la conclusión antes de explicar el modelo.
replacement: I think this also changes what people may be willing to pay for.

quote: He won't need to work to eat. He probably won't need to work to earn.
reason: Un futuro especulativo se narra como hecho sobre la vida del hijo. Cambiarlo a escenario, no a predicción asegurada.
replacement: If he grows up in a world where earning a living requires less work, what will give his days direction?

quote: Read that again slowly.
reason: Orden al lector que intenta fabricar importancia.
replacement: Eliminar; la contradicción personal siguiente puede sostenerse sola.

quote: That's the answer. You just watched it happen.
reason: Explica el significado del final después de mostrarlo.
replacement: Eliminar. Terminar en “Rewriting the last paragraph. Again.” conserva la escena y deja al lector sacar la conclusión.

quote: The crack is the crack. The pattern is the pattern.
reason: Tautologías que imitan profundidad; no describen qué patrón se reconoce.
replacement: Eliminar ambas oraciones; pasar de la comparación entre sectores al límite de esa comparación.

quote: The order varies slightly. The outcome does not.
reason: La analogía histórica se convierte en determinismo.
replacement: The sequence is a useful comparison, though it does not guarantee the same outcome.

quote: The company was the last community.
reason: Universaliza una experiencia profesional, pese a que el texto reconoce otras fuentes de comunidad.
replacement: For some people, the company is also their main community.

quote: are about twelve to eighteen months from phase two
reason: Plazo concreto sin método expuesto. La frase de seis a doce meses repite el problema.
replacement: may next discover that their team structure no longer matches the cost of iteration. [Quitar ambos calendarios salvo que haya base explícita.]

quote: The rhyme is not the answer. The rhyme is the reason to keep asking.
reason: Nuevo cierre de oposición abstracta después de un pasaje más útil sobre equivocarse.
replacement: Eliminar. Terminar en la reflexión sobre cómo los errores previos ayudan a calibrar la comparación.

quote: Not the most visible thing. Not the thing anyone announces.
reason: Fragmentos de suspense antes de nombrar el descenso de tarifas.
replacement: You notice it when the rate drops or a client hesitates. [Unir con los ejemplos que siguen.]

quote: That gap is not fixed by retraining. It is fixed by time.
reason: Más adelante, en la línea 440, se dice que la devaluación puede abordarse desarrollando habilidades. La oposición crea una contradicción.
replacement: Retraining takes time, and workers may face lower rates while they are still adapting.

quote: That is what vacuums do. They don't stay empty. They fill with whoever got there first.
reason: La metáfora pasa a funcionar como explicación; no identifica quién termina pagando.
replacement: Eliminar. Dejar la discusión sobre cómo se asignan las consecuencias de los errores, con su alcance por verificar.

quote: That is what every constitution looks like from the inside.
reason: Remate grandioso con un “every” innecesario.
replacement: Technical standards can embed choices that later become difficult to revisit.

quote: Not announced. Not replaced. Compressed.
reason: Tres fragmentos repiten “compressed” de la oración anterior para fabricar énfasis.
replacement: Eliminar estas tres frases; la compresión de la recepción humana ya está explicada.

quote: That unevenness is not a reassurance. It is a map.
reason: Consigna que retrasa el ejemplo de dónde afecta más la mediación.
replacement: The effect varies by task; the table below separates those cases.

quote: It is the permanent floor of direct human experience value
reason: “Permanent” presenta un límite futuro como demostrado.
replacement: These are the experiences this argument expects to remain most resistant to delegation. [Reemplaza la oración completa y conserva su carácter de hipótesis.]

quote: Build the asset now. The conversion path will clarify.
reason: Cierra una incertidumbre económica con una promesa de resolución inevitable.
replacement: Building the archive may help, but the revenue path remains unresolved and should be tested.

quote: The ones that wait for the metrics will find it occupied.
reason: Urgencia comercial de plantilla; asegura que esperar datos implica perder la posición.
replacement: Start with a small test in your own audience rather than assuming the same transition across every domain.

quote: You published something last week, or last month.
reason: Apertura que adjudica al lector una experiencia específica no conocida; pierde fuerza frente a un escenario explícito.
replacement: Suppose you publish a piece and the engagement looks normal.

quote: The system has no reason to filter them out and, increasingly, no way to tell them apart.
reason: Generalización sobre todos los sistemas de medición; el ensayo no demuestra esa incapacidad.
replacement: The question for your analytics is whether those requests are being counted alongside human visits.

quote: The room isn't empty. That's the thing. It's full. It's just not full of who you think.
reason: La metáfora y la frase entrecortada vuelven a explicar lo ya argumentado.
replacement: Traffic can continue to rise while fewer people read the work directly.

quote: The clicks are still coming. The question is who's making them.
reason: Aparece en 340 y 347; mantener el cierre una sola vez.
replacement: Conservar solo la aparición final, en el bloque de cierre.

quote: What you were watching, without either of you knowing it, was a proxy.
reason: Diagnostica una escena hipotética como si se conociera lo ocurrido.
replacement: One possible explanation is that more of the account’s activity has been delegated.

quote: Your professional reputation, in the most literal current sense, is a persistent queryable record
reason: “In the most literal current sense” fuerza una metáfora y “persistent queryable record” reemplaza algo cotidiano por jerga.
replacement: Part of your professional reputation is now a searchable record of what you have published

quote: The presence persists. The person keeps moving. At some point those two things are worth comparing.
reason: Repetido inmediatamente en las líneas 330 y 336. El contraste sirve; sobra su duplicación.
replacement: Conservar una sola aparición, como cierre.

quote: Nobody updated the playbook.
reason: Muletilla de cambio histórico que ya aparece en varias formulaciones del sitio.
replacement: The second filter changes what the first filter’s metrics can tell you.

quote: The agent summarizing your content doesn't care about the hook.
reason: Las secciones 1 y 3 repiten casi el mismo párrafo sobre los dos filtros, el gancho y la compresión.
replacement: Mantener la explicación en la sección 1; abrir la sección 3 con lo que se pierde al resumir y quitar la reiteración.

quote: The numbers keep moving. The optimization keeps happening. The gap keeps opening.
reason: Tríada de frases paralelas que fabrica cadencia sin precisar el efecto.
replacement: The metrics can keep rewarding changes that do not bring more readers to the original piece.

quote: The content that matters now is the content that makes someone want to find the source.
reason: Frase duplicada en el último párrafo y el cierre; “the content that matters” también excluye demasiado.
replacement: I want to write work that gives someone a reason to seek the original. [Usar una sola vez.]

quote: Nobody told you the rules changed. That's the part that stays with you afterward.
reason: Suspense genérico que presupone la reacción del lector.
replacement: A byline or a reply can lead a reader to assume a person is behind it.

quote: The support agent resolves your issue faster than a human could have read your message, and you don't wonder anymore. You know.
reason: Rapidez convertida en prueba de autoría: reproduce justamente el salto que esta auditoría evita.
replacement: A very fast reply may make you wonder whether it was automated; speed alone does not settle that question.

quote: the category of online presences you assumed were people
reason: La categoría abstracta interrumpe una experiencia que se entiende con verbos comunes.
replacement: the accounts you assumed were run directly by the people behind them

quote: Neither position gets you back to the floor you were standing on.
reason: Repetida en 320 y 328; vuelve a una metáfora del piso usada muchas veces.
replacement: Either way, you now have to ask who produced what you are reading. [Una sola aparición.]

quote: None of it is the thing.
reason: Retiene deliberadamente el referente; forma parte de una secuencia de negaciones antes de decir “origin”.
replacement: What interests me is the experience behind the work.

quote: That gap is where the human still lives.
reason: Remate metafísico después de una distinción que puede explicarse sin grandilocuencia.
replacement: Eliminar; la comparación entre recibir una respuesta y encontrar nuevas preguntas ya funciona.

quote: Not: be more personal. Not: perform vulnerability.
reason: Fórmula de falsas alternativas antes de una recomendación más concreta.
replacement: Write from situations you can describe and questions you have actually worked through. [Sustituir el arranque y enlazar con el resto.]

quote: It is toward the person the content proves existed.
reason: Repetido en 335 y 341. “Proves existed” dramatiza y no ofrece un criterio de verificación.
replacement: They want to keep reading the person behind the work. [Conservar una sola vez.]

quote: It is a property of the person who produced it
reason: El ensayo centra Origin Gravity en la persona; Occlusion Bias distingue expresamente editorial gravity de personality gravity. Aclarar si es un cambio o una aplicación del concepto.
replacement: Here I focus on the individual writer; in Occlusion Bias, the same question concerns the accountability of an editorial source. [Insertar aclaración junto a la definición y conservar el término solo con esa distinción.]

quote: incompleteness here is honest, not lazy.
reason: Defensa anticipada del autor; evaluar honestidad corresponde al contenido y al lector.
replacement: These are working questions. I will revise them as evidence or experience changes the argument.

quote: AI systems as currently deployed have no persistent memory across interactions.
reason: Afirmación universal y temporal sobre una clase heterogénea de sistemas, sin delimitar cuáles. Necesita verificación técnica antes de publicarse como hecho.
replacement: For a system that does not retain context between interactions, what kind of continuity can the user reasonably expect?

quote: Nobody is building that mechanism back in.
reason: Declaración sobre todo el trabajo ajeno sin evidencia presentada.
replacement: What mechanisms would make providers and operators accountable for the advice their systems produce?

quote: both are true simultaneously.
reason: Una sección de argumentos abiertos declara dos hipótesis verdaderas antes de probarlas.
replacement: Both possibilities are worth examining together.

quote: each one reframes a decision you're about to make.
reason: Promete que cada tarjeta modificará una decisión real del lector sin conocerla.
replacement: Short ideas from the essays, with links to the full arguments.

quote: 65 Ideas
reason: La introducción y el filtro dicen 86; el contador visible dice 65. Es un problema editorial, no indicio de autoría.
replacement: 86 Ideas. El HTML contiene 86 tarjetas con la clase “nugget-card fade-in”.

quote: Zero Moment of Influence
reason: El nombre desarrollado difiere del Zero Moment of Interpretation de la tesis.
replacement: Zero Moment of Interpretation

quote: Funnels Are Dead
reason: Titular de fórmula “X ha muerto”; simplifica el argumento sobre entradas múltiples.
replacement: Readers enter from more than one route

quote: Your Best Metrics Are Lying
reason: Personificación alarmista: los datos pueden estar mal interpretados sin mentir.
replacement: Check what your metrics actually measure

quote: Taste Is the New Oil
reason: Metáfora “X es el nuevo petróleo” intercambiable con cualquier tendencia.
replacement: Why selection matters when output grows

quote: Nobody Will Browse Anymore
reason: Predicción total que borra los límites discutidos en los ensayos originales.
replacement: When agents browse on a reader’s behalf

quote: If You Have to Explain It, You've Already Lost
reason: Confunde claridad con ausencia de explicación; gancho más absoluto que la idea que resume.
replacement: Explain the product before you scale acquisition

quote: something magical kicks in
reason: Muletilla promocional en una explicación de producto.
replacement: users have a clearer way to describe the product to others [Reformular desde “When that happens” y quitar la promesa de que cada usuario se vuelve un canal.]

quote: And here's the kicker:
reason: Gancho oral genérico que anuncia un golpe en vez de desarrollar el argumento.
replacement: Eliminar; revisar también la afirmación siguiente de que la coherencia no puede recuperarse.

quote: User from a friend's recommendation? Evidence of fit. User from an algorithm? Evidence that the algorithm found a trigger.
reason: La tarjeta transforma el origen en prueba suficiente de fit, perdiendo la distinción de comportamiento del paper 05.
replacement: A recommendation tells you how someone arrived. Retention and use tell you whether the product helps them.

quote: slower to build, impossible to take away.
reason: “Impossible” promete invulnerabilidad a canales e infraestructuras.
replacement: slower to build, and less dependent on a single recommendation system.

quote: Nothing survives in between.
reason: El resumen de The Great Contraction intensifica la falsa dicotomía.
replacement: The essay asks whether the middle is becoming harder to sustain.

quote: The fastest-growing market in tech is the market for less tech.
reason: Superlativo cuantitativo sin comparación o medición expuesta.
replacement: Some people pay for tools that limit how much technology they use.

quote: A person who can reason well is a hundred times more productive.
reason: Multiplicador no sustentado; no debe sobrevivir como dato al comprimir una hipérbole.
replacement: The value of the output still depends on how well the person directs and checks the work.

quote: The Floor Was Made of Assumptions
reason: La tarjeta vuelve a narrar la misma metáfora en título, cita y explicación.
replacement: Who do readers think is answering? [Desarrollar la pregunta una vez y enlazar al ensayo.]

quote: Together they provide inspectable evidence across media products, audience interaction, content workflows, editorial operations, AI agents, automation, and product strategy.
reason: Explica cómo debe interpretarse la reputación del autor; lista larga que los proyectos ya muestran.
replacement: You can try the products or open their public repositories.

quote: These remain supporting experience, not the center of the current work.
reason: Parece una instrucción interna de posicionamiento expuesta al público.
replacement: Eliminar. La experiencia de docencia y el programa pueden figurar sin jerarquizarlos defensivamente.

quote: His focus is not AI as a standalone category, but how it changes the systems behind media products, content, distribution and communities.
reason: Cierre defensivo de bio que vuelve a enumerar categorías ya mencionadas.
replacement: His current work applies AI to the research, production, and distribution workflows behind media products.

quote: The least interesting version of an agent is a synthetic personality performing busyness.
reason: Caricatura de una alternativa ajena que retrasa los criterios útiles.
replacement: I evaluate agents by the work they can complete, the limits on their actions, and how they report problems.

quote: None of those jobs require pretending the agent is a colleague with a favorite coffee.
reason: Burla innecesaria; además el lenguaje personal de agentes aparece en los ensayos del propio sitio.
replacement: Eliminar. Conservar los ejemplos de investigación, metadata y programación.

quote: New work belongs here when there is something real to inspect, not when there is only a claim.
reason: Regla del proceso editorial insertada como cierre público.
replacement: Eliminar; los enlaces a proyectos ya cumplen esa función.

quote: The site is now organized as a decision path, not a storage room.
reason: Lenguaje de rediseño interno y contraste con una mala experiencia no solicitada.
replacement: Each route starts with a problem and suggests what to read next.

quote: A retrieval-friendly map of the site
reason: Describe la optimización para máquinas en lugar de la utilidad del glosario.
replacement: The ideas used throughout these essays

quote: teams that solved the thing but not the read of the thing.
reason: “Thing / read of the thing” resulta opaco justo donde se promete lenguaje claro.
replacement: teams whose product solves a problem that potential users do not yet recognize

quote: Send the context, not a puzzle.
reason: Tiene carácter, pero el reproche inicial puede ser innecesario para una consulta profesional.
replacement: Tell me what you are working on and where you need help.

quote: This is not a chronological blog.
reason: Explica qué no es el sitio en vez de facilitar la elección.
replacement: Choose a topic below, or follow a reading path.

quote: Use this when you want signal before commitment.
reason: Abstracción de navegación que también aparece en Notes.
replacement: Start here if you want a short idea before choosing an essay.

quote: launches either survive mediation or disappear.
reason: Final binario y dramático para explicar un índice.
replacement: launches depend on how people discover and understand the product.

quote: I've spent more than 15 years building digital media companies, products, marketing, content, audiences, and communities.
reason: Inventario de categorías que vuelve en varias páginas; “building marketing” también resulta forzado.
replacement: I co-founded Posta and helped build Roxom TV’s global operation. My work spans media products, marketing, content, and the teams and tools behind them.

quote: small experiments that make an operational idea inspectable.
reason: “Inspectable” describe el objetivo de documentación más que el valor para el visitante.
replacement: small tools you can try

quote: the authoritative background.
reason: La autoridad se autodeclara en un enlace de navegación.
replacement: my background.

quote: His focus is not AI as a standalone category, but how it changes the systems behind media products, content, distribution and communities.
reason: La misma bio de About; resolverla una vez y mantener la versión oficial sincronizada.
replacement: His current work applies AI to the research, production, and distribution workflows behind media products.

quote: A current repository-approved press headshot is not published on this site yet.
reason: “Repository-approved” filtra jerga de implementación al lector de prensa.
replacement: For a current press photo, contact Diego.

quote: signal before commitment: shorter arguments, sharper entries, and active fragments before the larger shelves.
reason: Metáforas de señal y estantes, más una tríada, para decir algo simple.
replacement: short ideas and work in progress before choosing a longer essay.

quote: A small site with a small data surface.
reason: “Data surface” no ayuda al lector de una política de privacidad.
replacement: What information this site receives and how it is used.

quote: These are the strongest read-this-in-order routes in the publication.
reason: Autoevaluación genérica; el usuario necesita saber qué encontrará.
replacement: Choose Narrative-First for product and launch decisions, or After You Post for AI, readers, and trust.

quote: not a generic AI keynote.
reason: Diferenciación por descalificación vaga.
replacement: Eliminar el inciso: la experiencia operativa y los temas ya diferencian la propuesta.

quote: The AI-native newsroom is not an AI newsroom
reason: Distinción circular que necesita interpretación para funcionar como título.
replacement: Where AI helps in a newsroom, and where editors still decide

quote: That was the opening. It was also the constraint.
reason: Dos remates abstractos antes de la explicación concreta.
replacement: Eliminar; la oración sobre crear programas y desarrollar el mercado expresa ambas cosas.

quote: Continuous live media is an operations problem disguised as a content problem.
reason: Otra fórmula “X disfrazado de Y” que separa artificialmente responsabilidades conectadas.
replacement: Running a live channel around the clock requires programming, production, and recovery to work together.

quote: without pretending uncertainty had disappeared.
reason: Atribuye una pretensión a nadie; la capacidad concreta ya quedó explicada.
replacement: Eliminar el inciso y terminar después de “support internal interfaces”.

quote: Not a résumé.
reason: Niega una expectativa que el visitante no planteó.
replacement: Eliminar y comenzar con “Two cases…”.

quote: For inspectable evidence beyond the case studies
reason: Jerga de verificación en un enlace cotidiano.
replacement: For more examples of what I am building

quote: Stay in Essays, branch into Reading Paths, or take the compressed path before coming back deeper.
reason: El texto añadido por JavaScript reproduce las metáforas de caminos y profundidad de los índices.
replacement: Read another essay, follow a series, or browse the short notes.

quote: Message sent. Diego will reply directly.
reason: Promete respuesta aunque Contact aclara que la aceptación del envío no garantiza contestación.
replacement: Your message has been sent to Diego.

quote: Typical response: within two working days.
reason: Plazo de respuesta añadido en el modal, sin respaldo en la página de contacto.
replacement: Eliminar el plazo salvo que Diego confirme que es un compromiso real.

quote: It is not just about reaching audiences. It is about forming the conditions under which audiences interpret, trust, and remember.
reason: El resumen reproduce la oposición y la tríada del ensayo, sin necesitar ese efecto.
replacement: It asks how repeated contact with a media source changes a reader’s understanding over time.

quote: It is not a separate “AI expert” identity.
reason: Instrucción de posicionamiento dentro de una presentación; ya queda claro por la trayectoria.
replacement: Eliminar; conservar la explicación anterior de continuidad profesional.
